The stadium is designed like a concert hall with good acoustics in mind so as to optimise the atmosphere on match day.[128] The corners of the stadium are enclosed and the stands are placed close to the pitch, with fans generating a "wall of sound" that can reverberate around the ground.[129][130] The design extends to the shape and material of the roof and the seating, such as aluminium soffit lining to the roof, and aims to produce cleaner and quicker reverberation times that allow fans to sing in sync thereby producing chants that are louder and last longer.[128] The stadium is also designed to maintain the character but noisier than White Hart Lane and facilitate a sense of "home".[131][132]
